name: Label
summary: Text that names a form control, with an optional required indicator. Use it through Field where there is one; use it alone only to label a control Field cannot wrap.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Font size and line height; large is also semibold.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: semibold raises the weight at any size.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: true appends an asterisk; a string or element appends that indicator instead.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Draws the text and indicator in the disabled colour.

inputs.name: htmlFor
inputs.description: Native for: the id of the control it names.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: A native label element holding the text.

anatomy.name: Required indicator
anatomy.description: A span after the text, an asterisk by default, in red with a small gap before it.

variants.description: Declares no weight; see the gotcha.

layout.text: The label is fontFamilyBase in colorNeutralForeground1 at the size's font size and line height; it sets no display, padding or margin, so it flows inline like the native element.
The required indicator is colorPaletteRedForeground3 with spacingHorizontalXS before it, in the label's font.

states.text: Rest: colorNeutralForeground1 text, colorPaletteRedForeground3 indicator. A label has no hover or pressed look.
Not focusable and draws no indicator; clicking it focuses the control named by htmlFor, which draws its own.
The text and the required indicator both turn colorNeutralForegroundDisabled.

behaviour.text: As a native label, a click on it moves focus to (or toggles) the control whose id is its for.
required true renders an asterisk; a string or element renders that content in the indicator's style instead.

keyboard: None; not in the tab order
semantics: Names its control through for and id, or through aria-labelledby when Field wires it
The asterisk is visual only; the control must carry aria-required itself

notes.text: weight regular sets no font weight at all: the label inherits whatever weight its parent has. Set fontWeightRegular explicitly when rendering without CSS inheritance, or inside a bold context.
Large is semibold regardless of weight; there is no large regular label.
The required indicator reads colorPaletteRedForeground3, while Field's error text reads colorPaletteRedForeground1; the two reds differ in light and dark themes.
Under forced colours a disabled label and its indicator turn GrayText; otherwise the high-contrast theme's aliases apply, in which the red indicator resolves to the same white as the text.
The asterisk's accessibility (visual only, aria-required on the control) follows the design site's guidance; the styles file only colours it.
